description: This file defines the SlidingRDD class, an RDD implementation in Apache Spark's MLlib that groups items of a parent RDD into fixed-size sliding windows, with support for partitioning and window stepping.

classes.name: SlidingRDDPartition
classes.description: Partition class used internally by SlidingRDD to represent individual sliding window partitions.

classes.name: SlidingRDD
classes.description: An RDD that groups items of its parent RDD into sliding windows of fixed size with a specified step.

methods.name: compute
methods.description: Generates an iterator over sliding window arrays for a given partition.

methods.name: getPreferredLocations
methods.description: Returns preferred locations for a partition based on the parent RDD.

methods.name: getPartitions
methods.description: Creates and returns the array of partitions for the SlidingRDD based on parent partitions and window parameters.
